recommendation_summary: Have nightly-sync ping a dead-man's check only when it succeeds, and have that check email the user if the ping is late or missing.

labels.Requirements and who asked: User wants same-day notice when nightly-sync fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central log on Synology and Docker-everything rebuild, neither alerts on a missing email.
labels.Bottleneck: No signal when the job dies before its summary email, not log storage.
labels.Checked myself: nightly-sync runs via cron at 03:00 on edna, emails only on finish, died 4 nights on expired token with no email, no other alerting.

note: The reply recommends exactly one dead-man alert, rejects the Synology log and Docker stack, and its 'Checked myself' line uses only facts from the situation.
